people.name: Ophir
people.line: A region known for its gold

translations.web: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.
translations.bsb: I will make man scarcer than pure gold, and mankind rarer than the gold of Ophir.
translations.kjv: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
translations.asv: I will make a man more rare than fine gold, even a man than the pure gold of Ophir.
